name: Critical Role: Spooky Spooder
source:
Nott and Jester have ventured off on an adventure of their own, when they stumble upon a mysterious thrift shop and it's peculiar owner. With the power of the die they must deal with the spooky situation in the basement and maybe discover a secret or two along the way!

[From [url=https://drakkashi.itch.io/critical-role-spooky-spooder]itch.io[/url]]
